Definition: from τρύζω (to murmur; akin to G5149, but denoting a duller sound); a turtle-dove (as cooing):--turtle-dove.
BiblicalUsage: trygṓn describes a turtle-dove. It appears once, in Luke 2:24.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe trygṓn belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
